crossRefs.note: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of…
Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away…
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious…
If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and…
I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…
But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to…

translations.web: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
translations.bsb: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
translations.kjv: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
translations.asv: But God will smite through the head of his enemies, The hairy scalp of such a one as goeth on still in his guiltiness.
